scripts.docker:clean: docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans && docker system prune -f
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm ci && cd ../backend && npm ci
scripts.docker:dev: npm run docker:clean; npm run install:all; npm run docker:up
scripts.docker:nuke: docker system prune -a; cd backend; rm -drf dist; npm run build; cd ..; npm run docker:dev
